Done — scope changes are folded into the spec (`specs/001-bookmark-manager/spec.md`, now rev 2), and it re-passes the quality checklist. **We're still at the spec gate — please review the revisions before I plan.**

## What changed

| Your request | How it's now specified |
|---|---|
| **Tags & notes** | New P2 story "Organize with tags and notes"; FR-010/FR-011 (add/edit/remove tags + note, plus tag-reuse suggestions); Tag added as a key entity |
| **Auto-fill title, description, favicon, preview** | Enrichment folded into the core P1 save story; FR-007 (attempt on save) + FR-008 (best-effort — never blocks saving, falls back gracefully) |
| **Duplicate → guide me to edit** | FR-009 rewritten: instead of rejecting, the app detects the existing bookmark and routes you to open and edit it |
| **Search covers those details** | P3 search story + FR-016 now match across title, address, **description, tags, and note**, plus tag-based filtering |

**Kept as you confirmed:** single-user, local storage, no sharing, desktop-first. **Folders** remain out of scope for v1 (data model won't preclude adding them later).

**Notable boundary I set** (please confirm): enrichment fetches metadata **directly from the target pages** — no third-party service assumed — so pages behind logins or that block automated fetching may return little or no metadata, and saving always succeeds regardless (SC-006).

---

### Your options
- ✅ **Approve** → I move to `speckit-plan`.
- 🔧 **Adjust further** → any wording or scope tweaks.

Shall I proceed to the plan?
